meta.title: Reviewing My Entire Watch Collection (Before I Sell It All).
meta.description:
Thanks Vaer! Check out my favorite watches here: https://vaer-watches.sjv.io/ironsnail

Whew! Watch collection time. It's kinda like our own Watches & Wonders here! Except we're in the woods! Way better! Still not positive we'll do a lot of watch content on the ol' Snail, but figured, why not show off what the watch collection was before it was no more? So, that is what we're doing today.

The Watches! In order:
- Casio F-91W
- CW&T Solid State Watch
- Casio F108WHC-7B
- Casio G-Shock DW5600E-1V
- Casio G-Shock GWM5610-1
- Hamilton Khaki Pilot Pioneer
- Vintage Omega Seamaster
- Ronnie's Vintage Omega Chronometer
- Vintage Tudor Big Rose
- Rolex Explorer II 16570
- Zenith Chronomaster Revival Shadow
- Rolex Explorer I 14270
- My dad's Rolex Sea-Dweller 16600

Boots I'm wearing!: https://ktku.co/sr
Hoodie I'm wearing!: https://wonderlooper.com
Jacket I'm wearing! (mind is vintage): filson.sjv.io/55yk0b

Jeans I'm wearing -- sign up for the email list as they'll be back soon! 
https://theironsnail.us/collections/bottoms/products/the-chapter-1-jeans

Can I interest you in a hot bowl of following ME and The Snail in other places??
- The Iron Snail Clothing Website: https://theironsnail.us

 / theironsnail

info@theironsnail.us
#theironsnail

The Iron Snail is a men’s fashion vlog starring a young man named Michael and featuring a snail no bigger than a quarter. The two are set on taking over the world of fashion by creating a clothing line to end all clothing lines. Until then, we’re here to tell you EVERYTHING you need to know about the best clothing out there, from the highest quality raw denim jeans to the warmest jackets to the sturdiest boots…the Iron Snail has got you covered. (written by Taylor, though Michael is sometimes known to talk about himself in the third person… xoxo)
